_note: Weights and thresholds of the GOAT ENGINE. The owner asked for best judgement, so these are the engine's own settings, unchanged since the first version. The engine reads them at every run.

transit._note: A double transit means Jupiter and Saturn both hit a target sign, by conjunction or by their full aspects, in the same sampled instant. It is checked in the D1 chart against the house, the house counted from the Moon, the house lord and the karakas, and in the D9 chart rotated from the Lagna against the rotated house, the D9 lord and the D9 karakas. Owner decision.

dasha._note: Owner decision. The antardasha lord need not be relevant. A window counts when the mahadasha or the pratyantardasha lord is relevant. Relevant planets are the house lord, occupants in the Lagna chart and in the rotated D9, the karaka, and planets that aspect the house by natal aspect.

rule._note: For ordinal, count and type questions the promise net is turned into a strength between minus 1 and plus 1 by dividing by this scale and clamping. A strength of minus 1 is the lowest option and plus 1 the highest.

quality._note: Life area quality. Severity points are the malefic points of the promise plus marker_weight for each affliction marker, as a percent of the full weight sum. Below mild_percent the outcome is positive. From severe_percent, with an active affliction dasha after the event, the outcome is separated. From very_severe_percent with an active affliction dasha, the outcome is severe, such as divorce. Otherwise challenged. These thresholds are provisional and the owner can set them.
quality.presumed_event_note: When the question states the event, for example that the native is married, set eventPresumed true in the config. The promise is then not tested, and the outcome comes from the afflictions and the activation only.
quality._activation_note: Owner rule. Activation is read from the prevailing windows only, active on the as of date. The lookback is no longer used.
quality._threshold_note: Owner delegated this call. Set to 50 and 60 percent so that separation and severe outcomes need strong afflictions active in the prevailing dasha. Only two owner cases are known, both challenged at 30 and 43 percent, so this is a conservative setting, to be rechecked as more cases come in.

relatives.rule: Owner ruled. All relatives are analysed from the native chart by rotating the D1 chart to the relative's anchor house, which becomes the Lagna of the relative. Only the D1 chart is used. The D9 chart and the Moon chart are not used for any relative. Only the prevailing dasha and transit windows, active on the as of date, decide the answer. The answer is formed from the rotated D1 chart alone.
relatives.frame: D1 rotated to the anchor house
relatives._min_dasha_note: Owner decision. A relative's prevailing window needs one relevant dasha lord.

combination._note: Owner rule. A combination supports an event only when its links appear in at least two of the three charts. Divisional charts beyond D9 and Jaimini points are not used.

excluded_outcomes._note: Owner rule. The engine does not decide medical outcomes, death, pregnancy outcome or speculative gain. The supplement received from the owner is reference text only.
